:::{#def-composition}
#### Composition

Let $g : A \to B$ and $f : B \to C$ be [functions](#def-function).
The **composition**
[@wikipedia_function_composition]
of $f$ and $g$
is the function $f \circ g : A \to C$ defined by

$$(f \circ g)(a) \eqdef f(g(a)) \quad \text{for each } a \in A.$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#def-inner-function}
#### Inner function

In a composition $f \circ g$ (@def-composition), $g$ is the **inner function**, applied first.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#def-outer-function}
#### Outer function

In a composition $f \circ g$ (@def-composition), $f$ is the **outer function**, applied to the result.

:::
